propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs OpenAI model targets using the ambiguous openai: prefix, signaling that v2 will change this prefix from Chat Completions to Responses.
Rebar's _pai_model in anthropic_model.py and _resolve_target in model_classes.py compose and return the ambiguous openai: qualifier for inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets.

ProviderSession's cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint override guards match only the legacy openai provider name, causing custom-endpoint routing to fail when targets are explicitly qualified as openai-chat:.

Normalizing all rebar-owned OpenAI target construction to the explicit openai-chat: prefix preserves Chat Completions wire semantics, eliminates the deprecation warning, and maintains custom-endpoint compatibility when paired with updated provider-session matchers.

Legacy openai: spellings in tests must be retained to prove backward-compatible normalization, while canonical documentation and examples transition to openai-chat: to reflect the operator-approved Chat Completions contract.
